hazel: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: three recurring legs — dropped trace headers = missing spans, replayed ETL batches = aggregation inflation, and periodic ETL checkpoint GC = transient lag. Need owners, short timelines, and a conservative backfill plan.
omar: I'll own the header propagation fix in the edge proxies and SDK glue. ETA 48h to ship + 24h canary. Plan: enforce X-Trace-ID header and add header-forward test on CI.
brynn: I'll take the ETL checkpoint durability change and dedupe layer for rollups. Plan: durable checkpoint to objectstore + sequence monotonic check before applying records. ETA 72h.
kevin: I'll coordinate the backfill and maintenance window. Suggest a dry-run first on staging then a live run during low traffic (03:00 UTC). Dry-run should validate parity.
oncall-bot: Postmortem doc published: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/200234 — owner reminders created.
hazel: Please add 1-line rollback for each change and any infra blockers. Also include a short verification query for ops to run post-deploy.
omar: Rollout: feature-flag header-enforce (edge-proxy.feature.header_enforce=true) -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours. Rollback: flip flag to false. Blocker: need confirmation from CDN team about header passthrough.
brynn: Rollout: enable durable checkpoints behind flag; enable dedupe worker off by default then gate on. Rollback: switch worker off and revert checkpoint to previous snapshot. Blocker: objectstore IAM perms for writer role.
kevin: Backfill plan (summary): 1) snapshot current rollup tables, 2) run dedupe+recompute in staging, 3) compare diff metrics, 4) apply swap if within thresholds. Target window: 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z -> 2026-03-18T07:00:00Z. Estimated run: 35-50m depending on concurrency. Rollback: restore snapshot. Blocker: need replica slot during swap.
devex-bot: Noted — pinged @cdn-team and @sdk-mobile for header passthrough check.
oncall-bot: Reminder set: owners-checkin-2002345678 at 2026-03-19T09:30:00Z.
hazel: Ops verification query (simple):
```sql
-- compare rollup totals after backfill
SELECT metric, sum(value) as total
FROM metrics_rollup_staging
WHERE window_start BETWEEN '2026-03-18T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-18T07:00:00Z'
GROUP BY metric
ORDER BY metric;
```
omar: sample CI test (bash):
```bash
# assert trace header is forwarded
curl -H "X-Trace-ID: test-123" https://edge-test.redwood/api/health | grep test-123 || exit 1
```
brynn: dedupe pseudo-query (using monotonic seq id):
```sql
INSERT INTO rollup_staging (metric, window, value)
SELECT metric, window, SUM(value)
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seq_id, metric, window ORDER BY received_at DESC) rn
  FROM raw_events
  WHERE received_at BETWEEN '2026-03-18T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-18T07:00:00Z'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY metric, window;
```
hazel: Success criteria proposals: missing spans <0.1% sustained; rollup diffs <0.3% after backfill; ETL processing lag <60s steady-state. If anyone objects, call it out now.
omar: fine.
brynn: fine. will add unit+integration tests to CI.
kevin: I'll schedule the maintenance slot and post runbook with step-by-step checks and a dry-run timeline.
hazel: I'll update the postmortem with explicit tickets and due dates: omar by EOD+2, brynn by EOD+3 (checkpoint + dedupe PRs), kevin runbook + slot by EOD+1. If any slip, update thread. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Acknowledge — reminders and calendar invites sent.
hazel: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after canary/dry-run. Keep updates short in thread.
